propositions: Cloud's three whole-project readers (get_parent_map, get_comment_map, get_issuelinks_map) have no test coverage exercising pagination beyond a single page (100 items), despite paginating via opaque nextPageToken cursor.

A regression net with mutation coverage was added to test all three readers across three pages (250 items), asserting cursor advance, both stop conditions independently (isLast and exhausted token), and that repeated cursor tokens do not spin forever.

The structural guard preventing unpaginated whole-project readers from being added silently was extended from DC transport source to cover Cloud's adapters/jira/*.py, with a vacuity test ensuring the guard itself does not drift.

A real defect (repeated cursor token causes infinite loop, swallowed to silent truncation) was discovered by AC4 oracle and filed separately as rebar:cabc-7a98-d173-4d7c without production fix in this change.

Cloud readers page correctly today (measured 250 items at 100/page recovered in 3 requests; short pages do not terminate the walk), unlike DC's offset-arithmetic bugs, but lack regression nets to prevent silent truncation on future changes.
